scope: Preserve current-operation and new-construction evidence for Cadence Crossing Casino while explicitly refusing to recycle legacy Jokers Wild geometry without a numerical point tied to the 2026 Cadence Crossing building footprint.

records.name: Cadence Crossing Casino
records.note: Current sources consistently identify Cadence Crossing Casino as operating at 920 N Boulder Hwy, Henderson, and post-opening coverage says it opened March 25, 2026 and replaced Jokers Wild on the same overall plot. Construction reporting describes a newly built replacement property rather than a simple rename or in-place remodel. A current Waze destination and other current directories establish the operating address, but the evidence captured in this pass does not expose a defensible numerical point tied specifically to the completed 2026 Cadence Crossing building. The historical Jokers Wild point 36.052,-114.99468 therefore remains excluded from runtime reuse. Address continuity is not treated as building-coordinate continuity when the successor footprint is newly constructed.

nextPhase: Capture a numerical point from a source that identifies the completed Cadence Crossing building/property itself, then compare it against the legacy Jokers Wild point before considering runtime serialization.
